notes.title: Big News: More Languages Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]I’ve just rolled out a huge update to make the game more accessible around the world. You can now play in:[/p][p]🇪🇸 Spanish
🇧🇷 Portuguese
🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇰🇷 Korean
🇫🇷 French
🇩🇪 German[/p][p]That’s 7 new languages added![/p][p]To make this possible, I had to swap out the old font for a more readable one. The previous font was great, and I drew it myself so it's a shame to let it go, but the new one makes the text much clearer, especially for non-Latin scripts. On the bright side, I also gave the UI a little polish, so overall it should feel cleaner and easier to use, even if it’s a small trade-off in aesthetics.[/p][p]This translation update was partially possible thanks to community efforts. If you spot any mistakes or have suggestions for improvement, please let me know, I’d love to make it better.[/p][p]Thanks a ton for all the support, and I hope this makes the game easier to enjoy for even more players around the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455194/71df1dbef281b1f6a7bcf6d5ed4fc0b80116dccc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo V2.0 is out!
notes.content: [p]Enemies now have a chance to drop potions! These can heal you, grant shields, stun all enemies, and more, so make sure to collect them before they despawn.[/p][p]A tutorial will now appear the first time you play to help you get started, and I’ve improved the feedback on several actions like hovering, playing cards, attacking, and taking damage to make everything feel more responsive.[/p][p]I also made a few quality-of-life improvements, balanced some stats to make the game feel both fair and challenging, and fixed some bugs (probably added new ones, sorry about that).[/p][p]A new song was also added, hopefully this will make the loop less repetitive, but don't worry because the full release will feature even more original music![/p]
